notes.title: DEVLOG: Unearth the Mysteries of the Island of No Return
notes.content:
[h1][h2][b]POVEGLIA: The Island of No Return[/b][/h2][/h1]

Our goal for 2025 is to reach one million copies in early access. The full version of POVEGLIA will offer 8 to 10 hours of intense gameplay, full of mystery, action and puzzles that will transport you to the tragic history of the island. We are a small but highly professional team, and we have put our hearts into this project. 

POVEGLIA is our first big step, and we want to build a strong community of passionate players.

If you have already purchased an early access copy, we would be very grateful if you could leave us an honest and positive review. Every comment helps us grow and keep improving to deliver the best experience possible.

[previewyoutube=u88NFegXal0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Next Poveglia Update.
notes.content:
Dear Steam users,

We are pleased to announce that an exciting update is coming soon for[b] Poveglia: The Island of Non Return, currently available in early access.[/b] This update marks an important milestone in the development of the game, [b]as we will complete the first level and introduce the corresponding final boss.[/b]

[h2]Update Details:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]First Level Complete:[/b] Explore an immersive and challenging environment, with quests and secrets waiting to be discovered.
[*] [b]Final Boss of the Level:[/b] Confront the powerful enemy guarding the end of the first level, putting your skills to the test.
[*] [b]General Improvements:[/b] In addition to the new content, we have worked on optimizing the gameplay and fixing bugs to offer you a smoother experience.
[/list]

[h2]Acknowledgements[/h2].

We would like to thank our community for their constant support and valuable feedback. Your feedback has been crucial in shaping the game and making sure it meets your expectations. We remain committed to continuous improvement and look forward to continuing to receive your suggestions.

This is the perfect time! [b]Poveglia is available in early access at an affordable price[/b] Once the game is complete, [b]the price will increase to reflect additional content and general improvements[/b]. Therefore, purchasing the game now will allow you to enjoy all future content at the current price, saving compared to the full launch price.

[b]The update will be available very soon[/b] Keep your eyes on our social networks and Steam forum for more details on the exact date and other important announcements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858573/95cac1a3ccd8420cdd7faa14d6e086b4f05a10d6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Early Access Updates and Thanks.
notes.content:
We are deeply grateful for all the support you have given us. Every review and suggestion is carefully noted to continue improving the game. [b]We are a small team, but full of talent, fulfilling the dream of creating a video game that can be at the height of the big companies in the sector.[/b] We know it is not possible to please everyone.

We know that it is not possible to please everyone, but we do our best to achieve it. Our early access is an opportunity for you to try a taste of what we are capable of and, [b]with your valuable feedback[/b], we are convinced that we can make Poveglia: The Island of No Return [b]into a great game[/b].

We have released a new update based on some of your suggestions:

[list]
[*] [b]▶️ AI improvements:[/b] Enemies now have a more realistic and challenging behavior.
[*] [b]▶️ Dodge and dash controls:[/b] Can be performed by pressing the W, A, S or D keys twice.
[*] [b]▶️ Language fonts:[/b] Korean, Chinese and Japanese fonts are now at 100%. In addition, we have added support for Arabic.
[*] [b]▶️ Guide effect:[/b] We have added a new effect to facilitate navigation in the game.
[*] [b]▶️ Image translation:[/b] Document images are still in translation process, but we are working to complete them soon.
[/list]
The full game will last approximately 8 to 10 hours.

We will be taking a short break to recharge, but starting in January we will be back at 100% to continue working and bring you the best experience possible.

Thank you for being part of this exciting journey with us!

[b]Sincerely,
The INTI GAMES PRODUCTIONS[/b] team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43858573/d8df8b55aa8a677b1b6080a9d4fc9f7042185550.jpg[/img]

notes.title: POVEGLIA UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello, dear gamers of action, survival, and horror!

We are deeply grateful for all the support you have given us. Every review and suggestion is carefully noted to keep improving the game. We are a small but talented team, fulfilling the dream of creating a video game that can stand alongside the industry's giants.

We know it’s impossible to please everyone, but we give our all to achieve it. Our early access is an opportunity for you to try a sample of what we are capable of, and with your valuable feedback, we are confident we can turn Poveglia: The Island of No Return into a great game.

Today, December 24, we’ve launched an update based on some of your suggestions:

AI improvements: Enemies now exhibit more realistic and challenging behavior.
Dodge and dash controls: These can now be performed by double-tapping the W, A, S, or D keys.
Language fonts: Korean, Chinese, and Japanese fonts are now 100% complete. We’ve also added support for Arabic.
Guidance effect: A new effect has been added to make navigation in the game easier.
Image translation: Document images are still in the process of translation, but we’re working hard to complete them soon.
The full game will have an approximate duration of 8 to 10 hours.

We’ll be taking a short break to recharge, but starting in January, we’ll return at full capacity to continue working and bring you the best possible experience.

Thank you for being part of this exciting journey with us!

Sincerely,
The INTI GAMES PRODUCTIONS team

notes.title: UPDATE: IMPROVED ENVIRONMENT AND DAMAGE SYSTEM!
notes.content:
[h1][b]New Poveglia Update on Steam![/b][/h1]

We are pleased to announce an exciting update for Poveglia, our third-person survival horror game. In this release, we have worked hard to improve several key aspects of the game, taking your gaming experience to a new level.

[b]Improvements in the Environment and Scenarios:[/b] We have redesigned the environments and scenarios to make them much more immersive. Now, every corner of the island of Poveglia will immerse you in an even darker and more immersive atmosphere.

[b]Dynamic Audio Implemented:[/b] We have implemented a new dynamic audio system that enhances the immersion and atmosphere of the game. Ambient sounds and sound effects are now more realistic and immersive, increasing the tension and suspense as you explore the island.

[b]Improvements in the Fighting System:[/b] Now, when the player is hit by an enemy, you will hear a heartbeat and a flutter in breathing. These dynamic sound effects increase immersion and will make you feel every hit as if you were there.

[previewyoutube=48P9fJPhtHI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=Ujd7qUb7EHU;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h2][u][b]Don't miss this update and dive into the darkness of Poveglia like never before![/b][/u][/h2]

[h3][b]Discord:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/D9pHjHm9]https://discord.gg/D9pHjHm9[/url][/h3]

[h3][b]Kickstarter:[/b] [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wbstudiosgames/poveglia-the-island-of-no-return-0]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/wbstudiosgames/poveglia-the-island-of-no-return-0[/url][/h3]

notes.title: NEW COMBAT AND AMBIENT UPDATE!
notes.content:
We are excited to share with you the latest progress in the development of our third-person survival horror, Poveglia. In this update, we have worked hard to improve several key aspects of the game, and we are confident that these improvements will take your gaming experience to a new level.

[b]What's new in this update:
[/b]
[list]
[*] [bImproved Audio: [/b]We have implemented a new audio system that enhances the immersion and atmosphere of the game. Ambient sounds and sound effects are now more realistic and immersive.
[*] [b]Música:[/b] The soundtrack has been completely revamped to heighten the tension and suspense as you explore the island of Poveglia.
[*] [b]Melee Combat and Dodge: [/b]We have optimized and improved the character's melee and dash mechanics. Now, attacks and dodges are more fluid and responsive, allowing you to engage enemies more effectively.
[*][b] Visual Effects:[/b] New visual effects have been added that represent in a more striking way when the player takes damage, increasing the sense of danger and urgency.
[*] To see all these improvements in action, don't miss our latest development preview video:
[/list]

[previewyoutube=WJHmm43AIXw;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm! We continue to work to make Poveglia an unforgettable experience. Stay tuned for more updates.

notes.content:

[h2][b]Main Theme[/b][/h2] [h3]It is a composition by José Neumann. It represents the three main elements of the game: Melancholy, terror and the feeling of being in a completely abandoned place.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=3sSz2tGC5Is;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Heartbreaking[/b] [/h2] [h3]It is a theme focused on the confrontation that Detective William has against the different creatures that inhabit the island of Poveglia. Mainly generating the feeling of Danger, Tension and Anxiety.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=GEkH-xdFAq4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Nostalgia[/b] [/h2] [h3]It is mainly inspired by the historical context of the island, mixing a nostalgic and melancholic feeling combined with William's escape mission.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=viOeOqZEbYU;full][/previewyoutube]
